result.stdout:
USAGE:
    apl [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help    Prints help information

COMMANDS:
    status        Report the extractable strings per assembly, and translation  
                  coverage                                                      
    extract       Extract the source template from each in-scope assembly       
    add <lang>    Create a new language catalog for a template or across a scope
    sync          Reconcile language catalogs against a fresh template (--check 
                  for a CI gate)                                                
    convert       Change a single catalog file's format                         
    export        Bundle the target catalogs in scope into a zip for a          
                  translator                                                    
    import        Import a translator's returned zip, routing catalogs back to  
                  their origin                                                  
    merge         Flatten catalogs into one minified bundle per culture for     
                  deployment                                                    
    manifest      Write the catalog index the HTTP runtime loader reads

result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Bundle the target catalogs in scope into a zip for a translator

USAGE:
    apl export [OPTIONS]

OPTIONS:
                              DEFAULT                                           
    -h, --help                           Prints help information                
        --project [PATH]                 A project (.csproj or its directory);  
                                         defaults to the current directory      
        --solution [PATH]                A solution (.sln/.slnx or its          
                                         directory); defaults to the current    
                                         directory                              
        --recurse                        Include the transitively referenced    
                                         projects of the scope                  
        --source <CULTURE>    en         The source language the in-code        
                                         defaults are written in (default: en)  
        --input <PATH>                   A catalog directory to read            
        --lang <CULTURE>                 Export a single culture to one zip;    
                                         omit to export every non-source culture
        --output <PATH>                  The zip file (with --lang) or the      
                                         directory of per-culture zips          
        --format <FORMAT>                The format the bundled catalogs are    
                                         written as (default: xliff)

Import a translator's returned zip, routing catalogs back to their origin

USAGE:
    apl import [OPTIONS]

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help               Prints help information                            
        --input <FILE>       The zip file returned by the translator            
        --project [PATH]     A project (.csproj or its directory) whose catalog 
                             directory to write into                            
        --solution [PATH]    A solution (.sln/.slnx or its directory) whose     
                             catalog directory to write into                    
        --output <PATH>      Write into this directory (absolute: as-is;        
                             relative: per project); omit for each project's    
                             Translations folder
